name: Mana
description: The basic, all-pervading energy that is the foundation of all the planes of the Multiverse and everything on them, both a magical electricity and the soul of things.

description_citations.text: "Mana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The most generative force in the Multiverse, raw potential that mages shape into spells.

citation.text: "The Day a Vedalken Exploded". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.
